title: Finn and the Very Small Dragon
synopsis: Finn finds a dragon the size of a walnut and has to figure out how you protect something that refuses to admit it needs protecting.
plot:
On a hike through the mountains, Finn finds a dragon egg no bigger than a walnut, already cracking. Out comes a dragon with the personality of a full-sized one: it roars (a squeak), breathes fire (a match flame), and demands tribute (a raisin). Finn is instantly devoted to it. Jake is skeptical, because it keeps trying to set his tail on fire.

The Tiny Dragon insists on going on adventures. Finn tries to keep it safe by carrying it in his hat, and the dragon is deeply insulted. It escapes and challenges a hawk, a river, and a fairly large rock. Each time, Finn has to rescue it, and each time it declares that it was winning. Bubblegum runs a scan and confirms it is fully grown. It will never get bigger. It is simply a very small dragon, and it is furious about it.

Finn stops carrying it. Instead he makes it a saddle out of a bottle cap and lets it ride on BMO's head, where it can 'lead the charge'. The Tiny Dragon accepts this as an appropriate war mount. It burns a small hole in Jake's blanket to celebrate.
transcriptText:
Finn: Jake! Jake, it's an egg! It's hatching!
Jake: That's a walnut.
[The walnut cracks. A dragon the size of a thumb climbs out.]
Tiny Dragon: [squeaking] ROAR.
Finn: [tearing up] It's beautiful.
Tiny Dragon: [a match-flame of fire] TREMBLE, MORTALS.
Jake: OW. It got my tail! It got my tail, Finn!
Finn: It's just a little bit on fire.
Tiny Dragon: BRING ME TRIBUTE.
Finn: [offering a raisin] Is this okay?
Tiny Dragon: [eating it] ...Acceptable.
[The Tree Fort. Finn tucks the dragon into his hat.]
Tiny Dragon: WHAT IS THIS. RELEASE ME. I DO NOT RIDE IN HATS.
Finn: It's safe in there, buddy.
Tiny Dragon: I DO NOT REQUIRE SAFETY. I REQUIRE CONQUEST.
[Later. The dragon faces down a hawk.]
Tiny Dragon: FACE ME, BIRD.
Hawk: [picks it up]
Finn: NO— [leaps, catches it mid-air] Got you!
Tiny Dragon: I WAS WINNING.
[Candy Kingdom Lab.]
Princess Bubblegum: Fully grown. This is it. This is as big as it gets.
Tiny Dragon: LIES.
Princess Bubblegum: I have a chart.
Tiny Dragon: [looking at the chart] ...LIES.
Finn: [thinking] Okay. Okay. New idea.
[Finn presents a bottle-cap saddle strapped to BMO's head.]
BMO: I am a horse now!
Tiny Dragon: [climbing on] A war mount. Yes. YES. FORWARD, BEAST.
BMO: Forward!
Jake: [sniffing] Is my blanket on fire?
Tiny Dragon: A CELEBRATION.
